name: comp-328
blurb: Modal for updating credit card payment details.
description: A shadcn Dialog using react-payment-inputs for card number, expiry, and CVC fields; includes name, card type detection, and default payment method checkbox.
use_when: Collecting or updating payment card information in account settings or checkout flows.
avoid_when: On mobile with limited keyboard space — card inputs are best on desktop; handle sensitive data securely on the backend.
a11y: Card fields are labeled with IDs; card type icon is aria-hidden; all inputs keyboard-navigable via react-payment-inputs.
